name: dms-workspace-osd
description: Dev tooling for the Workspace OSD Flash DMS plugin; DMS itself never reads this file

scripts.reload: dms ipc call plugins reload workspaceOsdFlash
scripts.flash: dms ipc call wsosd flash 'Workspace 2: test' '' 'foot · Test A | foot · Test B'
scripts.test:hyprland: dms-testbed run hyprland --plugin . && sleep 2 && dms-testbed switch hyprland 2
scripts.test:niri: dms-testbed run niri --plugin . && sleep 2 && dms-testbed switch niri 2
scripts.test:mango: dms-testbed run mango --plugin . && sleep 2 && dms-testbed switch mango 2
scripts.test:sway: dms-testbed run sway --plugin . && sleep 2 && dms-testbed switch sway 2
scripts.test:labwc: dms-testbed run labwc --plugin . && sleep 2 && dms-testbed switch labwc 2
scripts.test:miracle: dms-testbed run miracle --plugin . && sleep 2 && dms-testbed switch miracle 2
scripts.test:all: npm run test:hyprland && npm run test:niri && npm run test:mango && npm run test:sway && npm run test:labwc && npm run test:miracle
scripts.test:switch: dms-testbed switch hyprland 3; dms-testbed switch niri 3; dms-testbed switch mango 3; dms-testbed switch sway 3; dms-testbed switch labwc 3; dms-testbed switch miracle 3
scripts.test:reload: dms-testbed reload hyprland workspaceOsdFlash; dms-testbed reload niri workspaceOsdFlash; dms-testbed reload mango workspaceOsdFlash; dms-testbed reload sway workspaceOsdFlash; dms-testbed reload labwc workspaceOsdFlash; dms-testbed reload miracle workspaceOsdFlash
scripts.test:restart-shell: dms-testbed restart-shell hyprland; dms-testbed restart-shell niri; dms-testbed restart-shell mango; dms-testbed restart-shell sway; dms-testbed restart-shell labwc; dms-testbed restart-shell miracle
scripts.test:logs: dms-testbed exec hyprland grep -h WorkspaceOsdFlash /home/tester/.local/state/dms-testbed/dms-hyprland.log; dms-testbed exec niri grep -h WorkspaceOsdFlash /home/tester/.local/state/dms-testbed/dms-niri.log; dms-testbed exec mango grep -h WorkspaceOsdFlash /home/tester/.local/state/dms-testbed/dms-mango.log; dms-testbed exec sway grep -h WorkspaceOsdFlash /home/tester/.local/state/dms-testbed/dms-sway.log; dms-testbed exec labwc grep -h WorkspaceOsdFlash /home/tester/.local/state/dms-testbed/dms-labwc.log; dms-testbed exec miracle grep -h WorkspaceOsdFlash /home/tester/.local/state/dms-testbed/dms-miracle.log
scripts.test:shot: mkdir -p screenshots; dms-testbed switch hyprland 2 >/dev/null; sleep 0.4; dms-testbed shot hyprland screenshots/hyprland.png; dms-testbed switch niri 2 >/dev/null; sleep 0.4; dms-testbed shot niri screenshots/niri.png; dms-testbed switch mango 2 >/dev/null; sleep 0.4; dms-testbed shot mango screenshots/mango.png; dms-testbed switch sway 2 >/dev/null; sleep 0.4; dms-testbed shot sway screenshots/sway.png; dms-testbed switch labwc 2 >/dev/null; sleep 0.4; dms-testbed shot labwc screenshots/labwc.png; dms-testbed switch miracle 2 >/dev/null; sleep 0.4; dms-testbed shot miracle screenshots/miracle.png
